Permanent exchangeEvery selected skin will be destroyed. You will receive one random skin of the next rarity.

HOW TRADE UPS WORK

Trade Ups let you exchange multiple skins for one random skin of a higher rarity.

  • Use 10 skins of the same rarity to receive one skin from the next rarity.
  • Use 5 Legendary skins to receive one random Mythic knife.
  • You can mix skins from different collections.
  • The collections you use affect which collection the resulting skin comes from.
  • Using more skins from one collection gives that collection a greater chance of being selected.
  • The wear of your input skins affects the wear of the resulting skin.
  • All skins placed into the Trade Up will be permanently removed.
  • The resulting skin is random and will not be shown before you confirm.

Trade Ups cannot be reversed.

COMPLETE TRADE UP?

All selected skins will be permanently removed.

You will receive one random skin of the next rarity from a collection represented by the skins you selected.

This action cannot be reversed.
